Move!|The boss soldier|}} A [[human]] '''individual''' served as an [[Imperial security trooper]] on a [[Unidentified planet (hill town)|planet]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. Between [[18 BBY]] and [[15 BBY]],{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-interview-stellan-skarsgard-elizabeth-dulau|text=Andor's Stellan Skarsgård and Elizabeth Dulau Break Down Luthen and Kleya}} states that [[Kleya Marki]] and [[Luthen Rael]] had known each other for 17 [[Standard year|years]] by the events of "[[Who Else Knows?]]" The episode occurs directly after "[[Make It Stop]]," which dates itself to [[1 BBY]]. Therefore, Marki and Rael's first meeting and Rael's subsequent defection occurred around the year [[18 BBY]]. "Make It Stop" establishes that the execution of the five civilians on a [[Unidentified planet (hill town)|planet]] takes place before the creation of the [[Axis network]], which "[[Coruscant: Whispers of Rebellion]]" states was founded a [[Standard decade|decade]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']] [[Andor Season 1|Season 1]], which takes place in [[5 BBY]] per the reasoning [[:Template:AndorDate|here]]. Therefore, the bombing must have occurred between 18 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and [[15 BBY]]. they commanded several [[Galactic Empire|Imperials]] to [[Death|execute]] a group of conspirators responsible for the death of a [[trooper]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The boss soldier first appeared in a flashback in the [[Andor Season 2|''Andor ''Season 2]] episode "[[Make It Stop]]" released on [[May 13]], [[2025]] as part of the final block of episodes of [[Star Wars: Andor|the series]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} They were portrayed by [[Liam Jeavons]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st}} {{Flash}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army personnel]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
